skill_name: Design a plan to reduce operational costs.
workflow: One strategy to reduce operational costs for a small manufacturing company producing automotive parts is to update their existing technology and equipment to be more energy-efficient. This can help to lower electricity costs. Additionally, companies should look into ways to outsource labor or offload certain parts of their production process.
